name: robotics-skills
description: Seven choose-and-loop robotics advisors: robotics-advisor (fundamentals + modern alternatives), ros2-master (ROS 2 architecture), robot-arm (manipulator integration), robot-hand (grippers to 5-finger dexterous hands), robot-mobile (SLAM/Nav2), robot-fleet (Open-RMF/multi-robot), robot-learning (imitation learning/RL/policies).
